$comment: EXP-1560 (was A-16): THE Devices page, one spec ×4 (web my-machines.tsx + device-logins.tsx, desktop machines.rs, iOS AgentsView + DeviceLogins, Android AgentsScreen). LAYOUT: each section (`mine` with its `+ Add device` pill, `team`) is a GRID of device CARDS: columns = max(1, floor((width + card.gap) / (card.minWidth + card.gap))) over the section's content width, gap `card.gap` both ways (a phone at 390pt gets 2 columns, a narrow one 1). Groups: online cards first in the list's own order, then the muted `offline` label spanning the grid, then every offline card in its own grid, dimmed (opacity 0.6). CARD = THE GlassCard surface (fill + hairline + radius), padding `card.padding`, two rows. TOP row: left a column of [name (truncates) + `v{version}` beside it (warning tone when the caller's own device is outdated, else muted) + the default star] over [the status line (Online dot / Last seen …) + the `This device` / `Shared` tags]; right the `⋯` overflow (a ghost icon button, `copy.deviceActions`) opening THE Menu. Menu items, in order: the update line (when the device has an `update` / `update_queued` attention item: its `text` as a disabled muted row), `Update` (only when that item's action is `update`; busy while requested), `copy.settings` (own REGISTERED devices; opens the Device settings dialog). A team device's menu holds only a team owner's `copy.removeFromTeam`; a card with no item draws no `⋯` (its slot stays empty). BOTTOM row: the logins as ICONS ONLY, in `sortDeviceLogins` order: each a ghost icon button (`card.iconSize` square) holding the agent's brand mark (`card.markSize`), THE run-mark badge (AgentRunMark `needs_input`: amber dot top-right, ringed in the card's ground) ON every login that has a `login` attention item. With more than `card.maxAccountIcons` logins only the first maxAccountIcons-1 show, then a ghost `⋯` (`copy.moreAccounts`) that reveals the rest in place (`accountIcons`). Own, online cards with an agent to add end the row with a ghost `+` (`copy.addAccount`). A device that reported accounts but holds NO login says `noAccount` muted in the row; one that never reported says `checking`. ACCOUNT PREVIEW: hovering an icon (pointer) opens THE hover card; a click (pointer) or a tap (touch) opens THE account menu (AccountChipMenu: Sign in / Keep signed in / Renew long-lived login / Sign out / Remove account, the existing gating; a team device's icon only previews, a tap opens the preview card). Both lead with the SAME header: the email (else the label) on top, the plan muted under it, the login's `status` line in warning tone when it has an attention item, then the usage windows (UsageWindows `hover` density: the 5h session, the weeks, the per-model windows, each with its reset). The hover card ends with a `Sign in` pill when the item's action is `sign_in`. ATTENTION (pure, `deviceListRow`): items in order: every login whose health is needs_relogin, then every signed_out login, then every OTHER login with `limitHit` (a fresh usage window at ≥ 100%; text `limitReached`, never an action), then the update line. A login yields at most one item. An AGENT with no login at all (a CLI installed, never signed in: `profiles` empty or absent) is NOT an item and badges nothing: the old IDE bug where mint read `Signed out` because Codex was installed. The update line exists only on the caller's own device: `updateQueued` when an update is parked behind live sessions (no action), else `updateAvailable` (with `latest`) when the client's own version compare says `outdated` (action `update` only for a SERVER — the CLI daemon is the one device that acts on an update request; a desktop app updates itself — and only while it is online and registered). Login actions (`sign_in`, never on a limit item) only on the caller's own online device. Team devices: read-only (no `+`, no actions), a team owner's Remove in the `⋯`.

cases.name: mint: codex installed but never signed in badges nothing
server with an older version: one update line with its action
a desktop app updates itself: the update line, no action
an offline server: the update line without an action
dead credentials first, then signed out, then the update
a queued update says so, without an action
a server that holds no login says No account and badges nothing
a device that never reported is checking, not No account
offline: grouped, items stay but nothing is actionable
a teammate's shared server: login items without actions, no update line
a login at its limit badges after the dead ones, never with an action

accountIcons.name: six fold behind the more button
